mapper.select: SELECT * FROM clients ORDER BY name
SELECT * FROM clients WHERE client_type = #{clientType} ORDER BY name
SELECT * FROM clients WHERE active = 1 ORDER BY name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO clients (name, address, phone, email, client_type, ampere_capacity, account_number, active, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{address}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{clientType}, #{ampereCapacity}, #{accountNumber}, #{active}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE clients SET name = #{name}, address = #{address}, phone = #{phone}, email = #{email}, client_type = #{clientType}, ampere_capacity = #{ampereCapacity}, account_number = #{accountNumber}, active = #{active}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clients WHERE account_number = #{accountNumber}
